# Experience

```{r}
#| label: experience
experience <-
  read_yaml("data/experience.yaml") |>
  mutate(
    why = sub("\n$", "", why),
    # what = if_else(duplicated(what), NA_character_, what),
    # where = if_else(duplicated(what), NA_character_, where),
  ) |>
  separate_longer_delim(why, "\n")

switch(
  BUILD,
  cv     = vitae::detailed_entries(experience, what, where, with, when,  why),
  resume = {
    experience |>
      vitae::detailed_entries(with, when,  what, where, why)
  }
)
```
